description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Amendement to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1921/67 of 04.07.2015 and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing parcel numbers, land extents, and encumbrances for various land parcels in different locations. It contains detailed land-related information including cadastral maps, parcel numbers, land extents in hectares, and servitude rights, making it clearly a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
